Know before you quote
Which earthing systems are supported?
TN systems. On IT systems, common in parts of Norway, charging works but load management does not.
Does the phase order matter?

Yes. Connect the LMC and the chargers with the same phase order (L1 to L1 and so on), because chargers switch phases based on the free capacity the LMC measures. The order can be corrected in the app afterwards.
Can I daisy-chain Ethernet through the charger?
No. Both ports support CAN daisy-chaining, but only one port can be used for Ethernet.
The LMC has a SIM. Is it online out of the box?
No. Mobile data is switched on in the VOOL App over Bluetooth during commissioning.
The charger does not detect the car after installation.
Check that the CP connector on the small cover of the orange charge controller is fully seated. It is the most common cause.
Is the back cable channel with entry from below a correct installation?
Yes. Water and snow do not enter through the vent openings.
What about chargers installed from 1 January 2027?
They must support ISO 15118-20. Order the new VOOL Charger, available from mid-December 2026.
